content: Simiyon le ghamba yakuyaku
Varɨvarɨma varɨiwoma thɨ govambwara wabwi theghewoniye iye Simiyon gha wabwi, uu na uu thɨ mena na thɨ wogiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku. Lenji ghamba yakuyakuko va ina wabwi Juda lenji thelau e tɨne.
Ghembaghembake thiyake va inanji e tɨne: Beyasiba, Molada,
Haja Sual, Baala, Ejem,
Elɨtolad, Betul, Homa,
Jikɨlag, Bet Makabot, Haja Susa,
Bet Lebaot na Saruhen. Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye ghembayaworo na ghembato na ghembaghemba nanasiye evasiwanjiva.
Ghembaghembake thiyake tembe ŋgoreiyeva: Ain, Rimon, Eta, na Asan. Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye ghembavarɨ na nanasiye tembe evasiwanjiva.
Ghembaghembako laghɨlaghɨye na nanasiye evasiwanjiko i wa ve wo Baalat Beya (o Rama), ina valɨvaŋga e yaghalako. Thelauke iyake uu na uu Simiyon e gha wabwi tɨne thɨ wo na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Kaiwae wabwi Juda lenji ghamba yakuyaku va i laghɨye kivwalaŋgi, iya kaiwae va thɨ wogiya valɨvaŋga regha weŋgiya Simiyon gha wabwi.
Sebulon (Jebulon) gha tari lenji ghamba yakuyaku
Varɨvarɨma varɨiwoma thɨ woraŋgiya Sebulon gha wabwi, uu na uu thɨ wogiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku. Ghamba yakuyakuko iyako va i wa ve wo Sarid.
Gheko teghalako i loŋga na i ghembeya yalasiko na ve wo Marala, ve laweya Dabeset na mbwa Jokɨneyam valɨvaŋga e boimako.
Sarid valɨvaŋga regha teghalako i loŋga na i wa e boimako na ve wo Kisɨlot Tabor ghaghad, amba i wa Daberat na i voro Japiya.
Mbowo i ghaova e boimako na gheko ve wo Gat Hepa na Et Kajin, i mwanavathawo na i ghembeya Neya gha ghawoko i loŋga na i ghembeya Rimon.
E ghaiwabuko, teghalako i loŋga na i ghembeya Hanaton, na ve ghad Ipɨta El malamoniye.
Na ghembaghembake thiyake tembe inanjiweva: Katat, Nahalal, Simiron, Aidala, na Betɨlehem: ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye ghembayaworo na ghembaiwo na ghembaghemba nanasiye evasiwanjiva.
Ghembaghembake laghɨlaghɨye thiyake na ghembaghemba nanasiye e thelauke iyake tɨne, uu na uu Sebulon e gha wabwi tɨne thɨ wo na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Isaka gha tari lenji ghamba yakuyaku
Varɨvarɨma varɨiwoma thɨ woraŋgiya wabwi Isaka, uu na uu thɨ tabo wabwivarɨnji thɨ wo lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Ghamba yakuyakuko iyako i wo Jejɨril, Kesulot, Sunem,
Haparaim, Siyon, Anaharat,
Rabit, Kisiyon, Ebes,
Remet, En Ganim, En-Hada, Betɨpajejɨ,
teghalako tembe ve wova Tabo, Sahajuma na Bet Semes, na Jorɨdan iye teghala. Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye ghembayaworo na ghembawona weiye ghembaghemba nanasiyeva evasiwanji.
Iyake Isaka gha wabwi, uu na uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku, iya ghembaghembake laghɨlaghɨye na ghembaghemba nanasiye thiyake.
Asa gha uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku
Varɨvarɨma varɨiwoma thɨ woraŋgiya Asa gha wabwi, uu na uu thɨ tabo wabwilimaninji thɨ wogiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Lenji ghamba yakuyakuko va i mbanɨŋgiya: Helɨkat, Hali, Beten, Akɨsap,
Alam Melek, Amad, na Misal. Teghala valɨvaŋga e yalasiko i mbanɨŋgiya Kamel, na Siho Libɨnat.

Amba i mwanavathawo na i loŋga na i vorowoko e boimako, ghamwae i ghembeya Bet Dagon, ve wo Sebulon na Ipɨta El Malamoniye, na iwa e ghaiwabuko ve wo Bet Emek na Neiyel. Mbowo i loŋga na i ghembeva ghaiwabuko ve wo Kabul,
Ebron Rehob, Hamon, na Kana ghaghad Saidon.

Ghamba ghadɨko ve njogha na ghamwae i ghembeya Rama na ve wova Taiya — ghemba gha gana vurɨvurɨghegheniye. Amba i loŋga na i ghembeya Hosa, e yalasiko na ve ghad Njighɨ Meditareiniyan. Tembe i wova Akɨjib,
Uma, Apek, na Rehob. Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye ghembayeiwo na ghembaiwo na ghembaghemba nanasiye evasiwanjiva.
Ghembaghembake laghɨlaghɨye na nanasiye thiyake inanji e thelauko iya uu na uu, Asa e gha wabwi tɨne thɨ wo na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Napɨtalai le wabwi lenji ghamba yakuyaku
Varɨvarɨma varɨiwoma thɨ woraŋgiya Napɨtalai gha wabwi, uu na uu thɨ tabo wabwiwonaninji thɨ wogiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Teghalako va iri Helep ve wo umbwa laghɨye ouk ina e ou regha, Jaananim e tɨne, i wa Adami-Nekeb na ve wo Jabɨnil, ve lawa Lakam na gha teghala Jorɨdan.
Gheko, teghalako i loŋga na i njaoko e yalasiko i wa Ajɨnot Tabo, amba i wa Hukok, ve wo Sebulon e yaghalako, Asa e yalasiko na Jorɨdan e boimako.
Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye e ghanjigana thiyake: Jidim, Je, Hamat, Rakat, Kiniret,
Adama, Rama, Hajo,
Kades, Edrei, En Hajo,
Yiron, Migɨdal El, Horem, Betanat na Bet Semes. Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye ghembayaworo na ghembasiwo na ghembaghemba nanasiye evasiwanjiva.
Ghembaghemba laghɨlaghɨye na nanasiye thiyake va inanji e thelauke iyake tɨne uu na uu, Napɨtalai gha wabwi thɨ wo na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Den gha uu lenji ghamba yakuyaku
Varɨvarɨma varɨiwoma thɨ woraŋgiya Den gha wabwi, uu na uu thɨ tabo wabwipirɨninji thɨ wogiya lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Ghamba yakuyakuko iyako va i wo Jora, Estaol, Ir Semes,
Salbim, Aijalon, Itɨla,
Elon, Timɨna, Ekron,
Elɨteke, Gibeton, Baalat,
Jehud, Beneberak, Gat-Rimon,
Me Jakon na Rakon tembe ŋgoreiyeva ghambambaro, Jopa ele valɨvaŋga.

Ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋa Den le wabwi gharɨgharɨniye thɨ thɨvaiya lenji ghamba yakuyakuko, thɨ raka na vethɨ gaithɨ Les na thɨ kivwalaŋgi. Thɨ gaboŋgiya gharɨgharɨko na thɨ wo lenji ghamba yakuyaku. Thiya yaku gheko na thɨ wogiya ghembako idae togha Den, rumbunji Den le ghaida.
Ghembaghembake laghɨlaghɨye na nanasiye thiyake uu na uu, Den e gha wabwi tɨne thɨ wo na lenji ghamba yakuyaku.
Josuwa le ghamba yakuyaku
Mbaŋa Isirel lenji randevivaŋgiko kaero thɨ giyavao thelauko iyako weŋgiya uu na uu, wabwi Isirel e tɨnenji, amba thɨ wogiyava Josuwa Nan nariye le ghamba yakuyaku.

Ŋgoreiya Giya Loi va i utu giya weŋgi, thɨ wogiya weya Josuwa ghemba laghɨye regha, Timɨnat Sera ina uu Epreim e lenji ghamba yakuyaku, e bobokuluko vanautumaniye. Va i vatada ghembako iyako na i yakuwe.

Eliyesa iye ravowovowo, Josuwa Nan nariye, na randevivaŋgi Isirel uu na uu e tɨnenji thɨ giya thelauko iyako ŋgoreiya varɨvarɨko varɨiwoko lenji govambwara Giya Loi le renuwaŋa Sailo e tɨne, e ghamba ruru Mevathavatha Ŋgoloniye ghadidiye. Va e kamwathɨke iyake thɨ tenɨvao thelauko iyako.
